description: This file defines SQLAlchemy ORM models for a gym management system, including user accounts, memberships, classes, sessions, trainers, bookings, and payments.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user in the gym system, including members, trainers, and admins, with relationships to memberships, bookings, trainer bookings, and payments.

classes.name: MembershipPlan
classes.description: Defines subscription plans available to users, including name, price, interval, and active status.

classes.name: Membership
classes.description: Represents a user's subscription to a specific plan, with start and end dates, status, and relationships to user and plan.

classes.name: Class
classes.description: Represents a type of gym class, such as Yoga or HIIT, with a title, description, capacity, and related sessions.

classes.name: ClassSession
classes.description: A scheduled instance of a class, with start/end times, capacity, spots remaining, and relationships to class and bookings.

classes.name: Trainer
classes.description: Contains trainer profile information, including name, bio, availability, and bookings.

classes.name: TrainerAvailability
classes.description: Time slots when a trainer is available for sessions.

classes.name: Booking
classes.description: A member's booking for a class session, with status and relationships to user and class session.

classes.name: TrainerBooking
classes.description: A member's booking for a one-on-one trainer session, with status and relationships to user and trainer.

classes.name: Payment
classes.description: Represents a payment transaction associated with memberships, class bookings, or trainer sessions, including amount, status, and reference info.
